metadata.case_name: YUEN WAI YIP GAVIN AND ANOTHER v. LEUNG CHI SHING

injuries.description: residual mild tenderness over bilateral cervical muscles
source: An objective examination of the 2nd plaintiff showed that there was residual mild tenderness over bilateral cervical muscles, but the tenderness over hips, elbows and ankles had subsided.

the residual mild tenderness over the 2nd plaintiff’s bilateral cervical muscles, which was mainly provoked after prolonged computer work as required by her job, “could be related to [her] poor sitting posture at work”.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

source: The provisional diagnosis was contusion to right hip, left knee and left elbow.
The provisional diagnosis was contusion to right hip, left knee and left elbow.
The provisional diagnosis was contusion to right hip, left knee and left elbow.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

source: There was also left knee abrasion[1].

manifestations.description: acute intermittent and deep stretching pain over neck and shoulder area, aggravated by forward or side bending of neck; acute intermittent ache over both elbows, aggravated by palpation; acute intermittent ache over both hips, aggravated by walking; acute intermittent pain over right ankle, aggravated by walking, going upstairs and downstairs; and acute intermittent and deep pain over left ankle, aggravated by walking, going upstairs and downstairs.
At present, she suffers residual pain on her neck and shoulder region.
She will suffer dull ache and stiffness in her neck after keeping the same neck posture for over 30 minutes and she will need to take a rest.
She said her neck condition has adversely affected her job performance as she needs to take more frequent rests.
She said that she also suffers ache and discomfort over her right hip after prolonged walking say, for over an hour.
she had taken 7 days sick leave before returning to work.

source: She was given analgesics and was discharged on the same day.

treatments_received.treatment: follow up consultation by Dr Sammy Lee up to 28 August 2011
source: she consulted a private doctor, Dr Sammy Lee, and received following up consultation from the latter regularly up to 28 August 2011[2].

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy (15 sessions) from Victor & Partners at Causeway and Admiralty between 4 July 2011 and 27 October 2011
source: she received a total of 15 sessions from Victor & Partners at their branches at Causeway and Admiralty from 4 July 2011 and 27 October 2011[4].
